summary: lowlydba.sqlserver requires ansible-core 2.19+, and explicit false values and several options (backup compress/encryption/azure, install_script deployment_method) now actually take effect.
questions: Why did my lowlydba.sqlserver backup become compressed after upgrading?
Does dtc_support_enabled: false now disable the setting?

answer_card.title: lowlydba.sqlserver breaking changes
answer_card.answer_md:
- `requires_ansible` raised to **>= 2.19**.
- `availability_group`: explicit `false` for `dtc_support_enabled`, `basic_availability_group`, `database_health_trigger` or `is_distributed_ag` now **disables** the setting.
- `backup`: `compress`, `encryption_certificate`, `azure_base_url`, `azure_credential` now take effect (previously ignored).
- `install_script`: `deployment_method` now takes effect (previously always `NoTransaction`).
- `login` and `sa`: explicit `false` for `password_policy_enforced` or `password_expiration_enabled` now disables them.
